scope: One opt-in public Burn backend extension and artificial forward verification only; no SmallForecaster integration, backward, updates, R2, CARE test or demand2015 evaluation
implementation: Public #[backend_extension(Flex, Autodiff)] with explicit f32::mul_add over contiguous Flex CPU primitive storage. Public Dispatch conversion retains autodiff NodeGuards and a handwritten three-parent backward node; no high-level to_data/from_data reinjection, private bridge access, unsafe Rust, f64 emulation or registry patch.
feature_change: Add non-default banto-ai feature fma-extension activating burn/extension and burn/autodiff. Keep Burn=0.22.0, existing default features and Cargo.lock unchanged. Only previously locked and locally cached dependencies may become active; offline/locked build, no downloads or new package version. Preserve original Cargo.toml/lib.rs before edits.
forward_domain: Finite f32 inputs and finite fused result. Shape/device/dtype errors are Result::Err before dispatch; nonfinite input/result are rejected by the kernel. Positive broadcast dimensions of equal rank; views/expanded strides normalized by the concrete kernel. Signed zero and subnormal bits are preserved.
oracle: Freeze input/expected bits using system fmaf; compare Rust f32::mul_add scalar and backend outputs to every expected bit. Include a known f64 double-rounding counterexample; do not select an implementation by trying arithmetic orders.
checks: 20 fixed scalar rows on plain Flex and autodiff Flex
noncontiguous view and nonzero offset view
shape, dtype, empty shape and device-context rejection
nonfinite inputs and overflowing fused result rejection
autodiff output require_grad and no high-level detach
backward_status: Code may be implemented and compiled to preserve graph, but no backward execution or correctness certification before original R1 passes. Gradients da=b, db=a, dc=1; broadcast handled by differentiable expand; alias contributions must later accumulate in R2.
stop: One implementation. Preserve compilation/plumbing failures in fresh roots; no scientific candidate retry after bit mismatch. Artificial forward success does not certify backward, model parity or R1. Model.rs stays unchanged.
